biggest_catch: Highly curated - you must apply through the Call to Artists with 10 images/videos and be hand-picked; most applicants are not accepted.
catches: Application required: submit 10 images or videos via the Call to Artists page; every image is individually reviewed by editors
Artists earn 50% royalty on Standard Licenses and 75% on Extended Licenses and Market Freezes; plus co-op profit-sharing (patronage returns) when there is a surplus
$1 USD one-time share purchase to join the co-op, deducted from your first sale (only cost)
Earnings are entirely variable - you earn only when your content licenses; no guaranteed income
Stocksy is a platform cooperative - contributing artists are Class C shareholders with a vote
